title: Components of Creative Arts and Sports
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Notes and pitches are described in words on the phone; draw the staff on the board. Fitness tests on the field.

skills.key_step: The child names the elements of a story: characters, setting (where and when), plot (events in order), conflict and theme.

floor.question: What is the setting of a story?

contexts: the hare and the hyena tale

board.do: Point at "in the forest at night".

misconceptions.ask: What is the setting of a story?
misconceptions.repair: Ask "where and when?" for three stories and underline the answers.
Ask "who?" for characters and "where?" for setting with one story.
Retell a story in three events: that chain is the plot.

misconceptions.ask: What is the theme of a story?
misconceptions.repair: Read a fable: the title names the animals, the theme is the lesson.

checks.question: What is the plot of a story?

skills.key_step: The child names health-related (endurance, strength, flexibility, body composition) and skill-related (agility, balance, coordination, power, speed, reaction time) components, with an activity for each.

floor.prerequisite: Knows a healthy daily routine (Grade 6 Science).
floor.question: Name one activity that keeps the heart healthy.

board.do: A zigzag run around cones trains...?
Write a component and an activity for each.

misconceptions.ask: Which is the ability to change direction quickly?
misconceptions.repair: Do a zigzag run (agility) and a sit-and-reach (flexibility); name each.

misconceptions.ask: Which is the range of movement at a joint?
misconceptions.repair: Compare touching the toes (flexibility) with lifting a heavy bag (strength).

misconceptions.ask: Which is lasting a long time without tiring?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a 60 m sprint (speed) with a 1,500 m run (endurance).
Compare a small learner lifting a heavy load with a big learner who cannot.

checks.question: Which component is the range of movement at a joint?
Which activity trains endurance: a long run or one jump?

skills.key_step: The child reads semibreve 4, minim 2, crotchet 1, quaver half, and groups notes so each bar of two-four time holds two crotchet beats.

floor.question: How many beats does a minim last?

steps: Add the beats as you go.
Draw a bar line after two beats.
contexts: a march for a school parade

board.do: A minim fills how many bars of 2/4?
A minim is 2 beats: one bar.

misconceptions.ask: How many beats is a minim?
misconceptions.repair: Draw both: hollow head and stem is the minim, two beats; filled head is the crotchet, one.

misconceptions.ask: How many beats is a semibreve?
misconceptions.repair: Line up semibreve, minim, crotchet and count 4, 2, 1 while clapping.

misconceptions.ask: In 2 time, a bar holds how many crotchet beats?
misconceptions.repair: The top number counts the beats: 2/4 has two crotchet beats in a bar.

misconceptions.ask: How long is one quaver in two-four time?
misconceptions.repair: Clap ta-te: two quavers share one beat.

checks.question: How many beats is a semibreve?
In 2/4, how many crotchet beats in a bar?

skills.key_step: The child names treble staff pitches: lines E G B D F, spaces F A C E, middle C on a ledger line below.

floor.question: What comes after s going up?

representations: a staff drawn on the board
steps: Lines: Every Good Boy Deserves Fruit.

misconceptions.ask: What are the lines of the treble staff from the bottom?
misconceptions.repair: Lines: Every Good Boy Deserves Fruit. Spaces: FACE.

misconceptions.ask: What are the spaces of the treble staff from the bottom?
misconceptions.repair: Point at a space: FACE fits in the spaces.

misconceptions.ask: Which note is on the bottom line of the treble staff?
misconceptions.repair: Count up from the bottom line: E (line), F (space), G (line).

misconceptions.ask: Which note sits on one ledger line below the treble staff?
misconceptions.repair: Count down: E line, D space, C ledger line.

checks.question: What are the treble staff spaces from the bottom?
Which note is on the middle line?
